purpose: One-shot baseline reproduction of F1, F2, and F3 against audited v1.9.0 / compared main 3efa3e02df56781960dfa8d0ecf143360c617ff8 before C1-C3 implementation.

F1_default_no_adapter_commits_locally.observation: CLI defaults to mode=publish and falls through to local git add/commit when NIZAM_MUTATION_ADAPTER is unset.

F1_empty_adapter_falls_through.command: NIZAM_MUTATION_ADAPTER='python3 -c "import sys; sys.stdin.read()"' python3 tools/start_path.py publish --root <disposable_repo> --capture <capture_path>
F1_empty_adapter_falls_through.observation: Adapter exiting 0 with empty stdout falls through to local git add/commit.

F1_empty_json_adapter_falls_through.command: NIZAM_MUTATION_ADAPTER='python3 -c "import sys; sys.stdin.read(); print(\"{}\")"' python3 tools/start_path.py publish --root <disposable_repo> --capture <capture_path>
F1_empty_json_adapter_falls_through.observation: Adapter exiting 0 with {} falls through to local git add/commit.

F1_finalize_mtime_mutates_git_index.observation: Read-only git status inside _verify_git_status_and_no_staged_conflicts refreshes .git/index stat cache when mtime changes without GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 / --no-optional-locks.

F2_untrusted_target_checker_fallback.stdout: bootstrap.sh: verify-only: PASS (content_integrity=verified) -- '<tampered_payload>' matches pinned tag 'v1.9.0' (STUB OK).
F2_untrusted_target_checker_fallback.observation: Standalone bootstrap falls back to executing <target>/tools/payload_integrity.py inside the untrusted payload being verified.

F2_unbound_directory_reference.stdout: bootstrap.sh: verify-only: PASS (content_integrity=verified) -- '<modified_payload>' matches pinned tag 'v1.9.0' (PAYLOAD-INTEGRITY PASS: 278 released files + genuine provenance; v1.9.0 at 0c9b1c5979a922c75499e0bfe4d9dbf9524f717d (source_root:<equally_modified_dir>)).
F2_unbound_directory_reference.observation: Unbound --source-root directory comparison reports content_integrity=verified citing the release commit SHA even when both directories have identical modifications differing from the release commit.

F2_required_check_downgrade_on_exit2.stdout: bootstrap.sh: verify-only: PASS (structural_only; content_integrity=not_checked) ... payload_integrity.py: error: argument --source-root: expected one argument
F2_required_check_downgrade_on_exit2.observation: Helper argparse exit code 2 is unconditionally downgraded by bootstrap.sh into structural_only PASS even when --expected-sha and --require-content-integrity are set.

F3_classify_and_capture_attempt4.capture_command: python3 tools/start_path.py capture --root <disposable_repo> --id t1 --step s1 --attempt 4 --output-dir .agent/evidence/t1 -- python3 -c "print('ok')"
F3_classify_and_capture_attempt4.capture_stderr: attempt must be an integer between 1 and 3 (circuit breaker cap)
F3_classify_and_capture_attempt4.observation: classify unconditionally reports max_attempts=3 and capture unconditionally rejects attempt > 3 with no mechanism for policy-permitted bounded continuation.
